# evroc_disk (Data Source)

Get information about an existing evroc disk.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the disk to look up.

### Optional

- `project` (String) Project this resource belongs to. Defaults to the provider project.
- `region` (String) Region where the disk is located.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the disk was created (RFC3339 format).
- `disk_id` (String) Unique identifier (UUID) of the disk.
- `fqid` (String) Fully qualified resource ID (FQID).
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `image` (String) OS image used for the disk.
- `size` (Number) Size of the disk in GB.
